scope: Training-only data expansion after v2 validation diagnosis. New distinct source-observed businesses, not generated descriptors, popularity ranking, human gold or independent evaluation.
collectionRationale: V2 memorizes canonical training names while validation has low feature evidence and spurious confident errors. Collect grocery/hospital/vehicle-fuel diversity because original training has only six groceries, six health businesses and three transport providers. No thresholds/features changed; no final-test inference or holdout enrichment.

businesses.name: Safeway

sources.evidence: Merchant page identifies Safeway as a supermarket/grocery retailer offering grocery products.
Arabic version of the same merchant page gives the observed name سيفوي and grocery retail activity.

businesses.notes: Groceries merchant default from the platform's actual grocery assortment; not every payment context. Observed bilingual names are views of one business, not independent businesses. No physical city branch inferred from site-wide navigation.

Index lists Sameh Mall as Grocery and Hypermarket.

businesses.name: TotalEnergies

sources.evidence: Official Arabic site identifies توتال للطاقات and vehicle fuel/card/car-care services.
Official Jordan fuel page identifies TotalEnergies and vehicle gasoline/diesel services.
Parent country page states marketing company was acquired by Vivo Energy on 1 July 2026.

businesses.notes: Vehicle-fuel merchant default; heating oil and on-site grocery/cafe purchases need context. TotalEnergies and Arabic branding are observed names, not a claim that ownership stayed unchanged. Do not add Vivo or Engen as extra independent training businesses.
